ground_truth.title: Affordable, Ethical, Sustainable Clothing Brands
ground_truth.author: Kristen
ground_truth.main_content:
I've been trying to find affordable, ethical, and sustainable clothing brands since I first learned they existed—which was about thirty years ago. But I've only (just now) gathered my favorite sustainable clothing brands and listed them all in one place—below.

I don't know why it's taken me so long to get organized in this way, to make my clothes shopping easier, but thank goodness for finally taking this step. Especially since it can bring such joy to realize nearly any style of clothing can be made more sustainable now.

While I shop, I remind myself that I'm paying fair wages for quality, ethical, and sustainable clothing so all can afford to live. I shop sales for more affordable pricing. I also buy in bulk (during sales) if something is truly needed in bulk (6 undies to replace 6 tattered undies).

I love to keep a minimalist capsule wardrobe, so I only buy items I need and love (everything must fit in my packing cubes), that mix and match (to create as many outfits as possible), that layer well (to adjust to climates/cultures), and that can be dressed up or down (for my style).

When I upgrade, I donate what I'm replacing.

And, of course, I choose clothes made from materials that are as non-toxic and cruelty-free as possible (while remembering everyone has different definitions of sustainability).

Organic cotton helps me say no to GMO seeds, fungicides/insecticides, synthetic fertilizers, herbicides, pesticides, chemicals for defoliation, plus it's naturally biodegradable.

Linen and hemp are often touted as naturally organic, and even better when certified organic. Plus, they help me enjoy antibacterial, breathable, and naturally biodegradable fabrics.

Tencel helps me choose renewable plant fibers made in an environmentally responsible process, certified compostable and biodegradable (here's why I try to avoid bamboo).

I hope this list of affordable, ethical, sustainable clothing brands helps others, too.
